entities.summary: Mohammed Zaman Kiani was a Pakistani military officer and politician. He is known for commanding the Kashmir rebels during the first Indo-Pakistani war (1947–1948) against Indian forces, and later serving as Pakistan's information minister under Mohammad Zia-ul-Haq.
